description: Master skill inventory for agent-workflow. Bootstrap copies to .agent/skills.catalog.json and audits the target repo.

tiers.meta: Install / upgrade this pack in a repo
tiers.core: Default LOOP and ship — install on almost every repo
tiers.planning: Findings → general plan → execution — program work
tiers.optional_revy: Post-push Revy — only when GitHub PRs run Revy
tiers.optional_sentry: Sentry MCP debugging — manual, user points at one issue
tiers.optional_validation: Staging validation memos — on user demand

skills.when: Install or upgrade this pack in a target repo
Full program LOOP — attach execution file or plan folder
Ship ad-hoc work: Bugbot → commit → push/PR when hosting allows
One subphase only — user explicitly asks, not full LOOP

skills.install_when: Repo runs phased programs with findings docs
skills.when: Research topic, scope work before planning
Turn findings into phased GENERAL plan
Write all per-phase execution files; inline LOOP ship gates

skills.install_when: Repo uses findings/general plan peer review
skills.when: Cross-check one findings, general, or design doc vs codebase

skills.install_when: Repo uses execution plans before LOOP
skills.when: Read-only review of execution files P0…Pn before phase-execution
Stress-test a plan or design doc

skills.install_when: Repo uses phase-execution on multi-phase programs
skills.when: Closeout — plan vs shipped, doc sync

skills.install_when: hosting.kind is github AND (Revy on PRs or integrations.revy)
skills.when: User asks: babysit revy — poll Revy check, fix revybot threads
User points at one Sentry issue URL/ID — manual only

skills.install_when: Repo exports docs to Word/PDF or handoff MD
skills.when: Fix markdown for GitHub + Pandoc export

skills.install_when: Repo authors mermaid architecture or stakeholder diagrams
skills.when: Create mermaid flowcharts with calm palette for Word/GitHub handoff
Export markdown to compact Word docx

skills.install_when: Repo ingests Word handoffs into docs/
skills.when: Convert Word docx to GitHub-flavored markdown
Create or update staging validation memo tables from evidence
